episode_definition: Any positive valid target pixel starts/continues an episode. Only 24 consecutive hourly samples with fully valid zero targets end it. Missing hours cannot establish dry separation; groups may bridge gaps. Labels are for evaluation grouping, not proof of independence. Event_ids retain the 12 legacy identifiers; use precip_episode_ids to keep whole continuous episodes together.
event_definition: Any positive valid target pixel starts/continues an episode. Only 24 consecutive hourly samples with fully valid zero targets end it. Missing hours cannot establish dry separation; groups may bridge gaps. Labels are for evaluation grouping, not proof of independence. Event_ids retain the 12 legacy identifiers; use precip_episode_ids to keep whole continuous episodes together.
study_coverage: Continuous requested study interval, with every hour accounted for in coverage metadata.

legacy_periods.selection_note: TTN/EWR were dry, but MRMS shows rain elsewhere in the region. Retained as mixed; not counted as a dry period or an additional independent rainy event.

evaluation_limitation: Episode count does not establish evaluation reliability or independence. No scaler fitted, model trained, or evaluation performed.
